description: This Java source file defines the MediaScannerActivity class, an Android activity that simulates media file scanning and insertion into the media store database, including generating random media data.

classes.name: MediaScannerActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages media scanning simulation, including inserting random media data into the media store and handling media scanner broadcasts.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, registers broadcast receiver, and prepares data structures.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up by unregistering broadcast receiver and removing handler messages.

methods.name: startScan
methods.description: Triggers media scanning by sending a broadcast with ACTION_MEDIA_MOUNTED.

methods.name: setInsertButtonText
methods.description: Updates the insert button label to reflect the number of items to insert.

methods.name: insertItems
methods.description: Starts or stops the insertion process of media items.

methods.name: addAlbum
methods.description: Generates and inserts a batch of media items (album with songs) into the media store.

methods.name: getRandomWord
methods.description: Creates a random word by concatenating random syllables.

methods.name: getRandomName
methods.description: Generates a random name with optional modifiers.
